result.description: Compact fictional internal archive module designed for studio post-production rigs and voice-lab workstations. The Lunar Nova stores high-fidelity session assets, sample libraries, and rendered audio stems in a single hot-swappable bay. It uses a PCIe-based controller optimized for sequential read/write workloads and low-latency project loading. Ideal for media indexing, session backups, and fast retrieval in creative production environments.
result.title: Lunar Nova 1.2TB PCIe Audio Archive Module
result.title_description: Audio archive module for studio and post-production workflows
